verdict.rationale: Casium publishes a blog guide to International Entrepreneur Parole that covers eligibility criteria, the application process, benefits, and criticisms, so the pathway is documented. It is an informational article, though, not a listed service offering. The excerpt also states no dollar thresholds. Missing for 10: explicit qualifying-investment and government-grant threshold figures, evidence that Casium offers IER filings as a service, and a dedicated visa-guide page or independent corroboration.
